terra.problem: The passage does not say nobody asked Josiah to come out or that he walked right up to Neco.
The passage does not say Josiah left Jerusalem to confront Neco.
Neco sent messengers; the passage does not say he delivered the message to Josiah face to face.
The explanation puts a paraphrase of Neco's message in quotation marks.

Neco says God told him to hurry, but the passage does not say he was moving fast or what was on his list.
Carchemish is by the Euphrates, but the passage does not establish that the river was right where Neco was.
The passage does not say Josiah heard Neco out; it says he did not listen to Neco's words.
Josiah's failure to listen does not establish that he failed to recognize the words came from God.
The passage does not say Josiah never reached Carchemish.
The passage says the laments were established as a statute for Israel, but does not specify that Israel was commanded to keep reciting them.
